name: Muhammad ibn Kathir al-Abdi
bornNote: Reckoned from Ibn Hibban's statement that he died in 223 AH aged ninety
diedNote: 223 AH aged ninety (Taqrib; Ibn Hibban); Ibn Qani' adds Jumada al-Ula

taqrib.ar: ثقة، لم يصب من ضعفه، من كبار العاشرة
taqrib.en: Reliable; whoever weakened him was mistaken. Of the senior members of the tenth generation.

role: Teacher of al-Bukhari and Abu Dawud; brother of Sulayman ibn Kathir; a transmitter of Sufyan al-Thawri

teachers.name: Sulayman ibn Kathir, his brother
teachers.source: Shamela narrator record 5889 (Zahrat al-Muta'allimin, via Ikmal Tahdhib al-Kamal 10/322)

verdicts.via: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Khaythama; Abd al-Khaliq ibn Mansur
verdicts.ar: لا تكتبوا عنه، لم يكن بالثقة
verdicts.en: Do not write from him; he was not reliable.
Reliable; he died upon the Sunna.

verdicts.ar: ذكره في الثقات وقال: مات سنة ثلاث وعشرين ومائتين، وكان له يوم مات تسعون سنة، وكان تقيا فاضلا
verdicts.en: Listed him in al-Thiqat and said: he died in 223 AH aged ninety; he was pious and virtuous.
There is no harm in him.

flags.label: Disputed; Ibn Hajar sides with those who accepted him
flags.detail: Ibn Ma'in and Ibn Qani' weakened him; Ahmad, Abu Hatim and Ibn Hibban accepted him, and al-Bukhari relied on him in the Sahih (a reported sixty-three hadith). Ibn Hajar's verdict in the Taqrib is that those who weakened him were mistaken. The chain here is also carried independently of him in Muslim, al-Tirmidhi and al-Nasa'i through other students of al-A'mash, so nothing rests on him alone.

bio: A long-lived Basran who heard Sufyan al-Thawri and Shu'ba in the 150s and was still teaching when al-Bukhari and Abu Dawud came to Basra seventy years later; both record this very hadith from him. Ibn Ma'in's harsh words about him stand against Ahmad's praise, and Ibn Hajar's Taqrib settles the matter in his favour. He died in 223 AH aged ninety.

provenance.ref: Shamela narrator record 5889, drawing on Tahdhib al-Kamal 26/334, Tahdhib al-Tahdhib 3/683 and Ikmal Tahdhib al-Kamal 10/322
Chains of Sahih al-Bukhari 1597 and Sunan Abi Dawud 1873
